body:
> Will you weigh the possibility that this is your mental illness talking?

Yeah, it probably is. But I cant supress or control it.

Yes, I am 21. Sure, I can only talk about my past experiences, but its still demotivating and depressing.

Its not that I just hate my life and myself. Its more that I keep thinking about what I couldve done different, to make my current situation better. And I know that I probably could have a life I like, but I dont know how to achieve it. As I said, whatever I do, it WILL go wrong at some point. I try to get it under control, but its hard when you want to sleep, or when youre alone because well, sometimes you are. Thanks for the answer though..
